Transaction map preparation and verification with parent-child link checks.

# Purpose
This C file implements the transaction management logic for `fd_funk`. It builds the concrete `fd_funk_txn_pool` and `fd_funk_txn_map` types by using the generic pool and chained map templates, then adds transaction-specific rules for state changes and publish tracking. The `fd_funk_txn_state_transition` macro updates a transaction state with atomic compare-and-swap when atomic support is present, and it reports a critical error if another thread changes the state at the same time. The `fd_funk_last_publish_transition` macro updates the shared `last_publish` transaction ID and logs the change.

The main API functions are [`fd_funk_txn_prepare`](<#fd_funk_txn_prepare>) and [`fd_funk_txn_verify`](<#fd_funk_txn_verify>). [`fd_funk_txn_prepare`](<#fd_funk_txn_prepare>) creates a new transaction, checks that the transaction ID is valid and unused, finds and validates the parent transaction, links the new transaction into the parent or root child list, sets the initial fields, and inserts the transaction into the map. [`fd_funk_txn_verify`](<#fd_funk_txn_verify>) walks the transaction tree in both forward and reverse order to check parent and sibling links, detect cycles, and confirm that the pool and map are in a valid state.
